global: This tonkotsu ramen boasts a rich, creamy broth, topped with vibrant green scallions and tender menma. Served in a decorative bowl with red accents, it rests on a dark wooden table under soft, warm lighting.

regions.background: Dark brown wooden table with visible grain patterns and subtle reflections on its smooth surface.
regions.bowl: White ceramic bowl with green dragon pattern and red Chinese character rim, glossy surface reflecting light.
regions.soup: The tonkotsu (pork bone) broth is creamy yellow, thick, and glossy, swirling with noodles and green onions.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear translucent, pale yellow, with curled, layered texture and a single green onion ring on top.
